subject: Co-branding rights request for contract credit — CloudPilot
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@cloudpilot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-branding rights request for contract credit — CloudPilot

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited about CloudPilot integrating with our real-time routing. Per our conversation, you asked whether we can trade marketing co-branding (joint case study + homepage logo placement) for a commercial concession on the Q3 commit.

High level proposal from my side:
- 20% one-time contract credit applied to the first 12 months
- Redwood permission for: homepage logo (non-exclusive), a one-page joint case study, and a short customer quote for use on our sales collateral and website (no press announcement required).

Im attaching a draft co-branding brief and the current term sheet so legal can quickly see the ask (term_sheet_v2.docx, co_branding_draft_v1.pdf). Two quick asks to keep timelines aligned:
1) Can you confirm the internal approvals on your side for a joint case study + quote?
2) You mentioned a June product launch — do you need the marketing assets and logo in place before June 15?

If youre aligned with the scope above well route this for a leadership trade-off approval (Ill need sign-off for the credit and marketing permissions). Happy to hop on a quick call with Marissa and Vivek if helpful.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: term_sheet_v2.docx (preview), co_branding_draft_v1.pdf (preview)
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@cloudpilot.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@cloudpilot.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-branding rights request for contract credit — CloudPilot

Thanks Rachel — that scope is close to what we had in mind. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Wed prefer the 20% credit as a headline term; its what the board expects for promotional partnerships.
- In addition to homepage placement and a one-page case study, wed like the option for a short joint press blurb the week of launch (just a paragraph we can both post).
- Timeline: yes, ideally assets in place by June 10 so we can coordinate the launch calendar.

If you can get leadership to confirm the 20% and press blurb option, well route it through procurement and legal immediately.

— Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Partnerships | CloudPilot
sarah.nguyen@cloudpilot.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Co-branding rights request for contract credit — CloudPilot

Marissa — escalating for deal-desk / leadership guidance. Customer (CloudPilot) expects 20% credit in exchange for: homepage logo, one-page joint case study, and a short press blurb the week of their launch (June ~15). They want assets by June 10.

Why this matters: CloudPilot is high-priority (large product launch, strong logo for our enterprise sales motion). We can likely recover cost via volume, but press blurb + quote introduces PR/legal exposure.

Questions for the desk / leadership:
- Approve 20% one-time credit applied to year-one ARR?
- Approve co-branding scope OR require limits (no press blurb, homepage only, review of quote text)?
- Any marketing fund or alternate trade (e.g., reduced credit + paid marketing support) we should propose instead?

Ive attached the draft brief. If ok Ill draft the DocuSign and route to procurement.

-Rachel

Attachments: co_branding_draft_v1.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-branding rights request for contract credit — CloudPilot

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick read and decision guidance:
- Strategic value: CloudPilot is a credible debut customer in the observability space; homepage presence + case study is valuable for us.
- PR exposure: Im not comfortable signing off on a joint press announcement without legal sign-off on both parties quotes. A press blurb is higher risk (quote accuracy, timing).

I propose the following trade we can approve today:
1) Approve a 10% one-time credit on first 12 months (instead of 20%).
2) Approve homepage logo placement and a one-page case study (Redwood controls final quote text; CloudPilot gets first review).
3) Deny unilateral press blurb rights — we can agree to coordinate a short joint announcement but only if both comms teams sign off and legal clears the language; otherwise no press wording in the contract.
4) Offer $50k co-marketing fund (credits toward joint paid promotion) as an alternative to the additional discount.

Marissa — can you confirm the ROI numbers for a 10% concession vs 20% and whether $50k fund is feasible from pipeline marketing budget? If finance is a hard line Id prefer the $50k+$10% approach over a straight 20% hit.

Vivek
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-branding rights request for contract credit — CloudPilot

All — Ive run the numbers with finance. Summary:
- 10% one-time credit + $50k co-marketing fund is acceptable and preserves new-logo economics.
- 20% one-time credit would cut into target ACV too deeply for this segment.

Next steps Ill take:
1) Legal to redline the co-branding brief to explicitly remove unilateral press blurb rights and to add approval cadence for quote language (LR assigned: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com).
2) Draft contract amendment with 10% credit + $50k marketing fund and circulate for signature.
3) Send a short form approval note back to CloudPilot: confirm homepage logo + one-page case study, no press blurb without joint comms approval. Include DocuSign link and proposed asset timeline (assets due by June 10).

Rachel — Ill finalize language and route the DocuSign today. Once legal completes the redline Lauren, please confirm youre ok to send to Sarah.

Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
